name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. After a decade managing supply chains for a construction firm, a chance encounter with a local rally team ignited a passion he never knew he possessed. He quickly realized the logistical challenges of motorsport were far more intricate and demanding than anything he'd faced before. Ricardo thrives on the pressure of ensuring everything arrives on time, from spare parts to fuel, keeping the team running smoothly. 

He joined Elite Motorsport five years ago and has been instrumental in their recent successes. Ricardo's methodical approach and uncanny ability to anticipate problems before they arise make him an invaluable asset. While he prefers working independently, he understands the importance of teamwork and always ensures his efforts support the team's overall goals. He's not afraid to challenge decisions if he believes a better solution exists, making him a respected voice within the organization. His experience and dedication make him an invaluable member of the team.

Ricardo is known for his meticulous nature; every item has its place, and every process is carefully documented. He believes that proper planning prevents poor performance, and this philosophy guides his every action. While some may find his approach overly cautious, no one can deny the results he consistently delivers.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height with a slightly stocky build, suggesting a life spent both indoors and outdoors.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even to informal meetings.
Insists on organizing the team's transport vans himself, regardless of the destination.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
